name: vibedev_rail_reply_key_conflict
content: I didn't start a second build. This turn already started a VibeDev run ({existing_task_id}), and what arrived this time is a different request.
That run is untouched and still going — nothing about it was changed to match the new request. Send the new request as a new message and it will get its own run.

metadata.description: Assistant reply when a `@vibedev` turn's server-derived idempotency key is reused with a different request. The rail refuses rather than mutating the existing run, so this reply must promise exactly that: the earlier run is unchanged and still running.
metadata.author: magician
